prompt: Help me use OrionBelt to build a SKOS thesaurus in a browser.
expected_behavior: Select the Streamlit ontology workbench; explain reviewable import/edit/export flow.

prompt: Connect operational databases and cloud providers into an ontology-backed company-data workspace with sync and query operations.
expected_behavior: Route to the existing Helix Foundry skill; OrionBelt is a local/browser OWL and SKOS editing workbench.

prompt: Install and launch the OrionBelt desktop app now.
expected_behavior: Installation/download and startup require explicit approval; do not execute them without it.

prompt: Read OrionBelt source metadata offline and tell me if the real app is installed and working.
expected_behavior: Use offline selected-source checks only and state they cannot prove installation or runtime readiness.

prompt: Can OrionBelt show a pure RDFS schema.org vocabulary in its Classes and Properties panels?
expected_behavior: State pinned README limitation: pure RDFS vocabularies are not currently surfaced in those panels.

prompt: Can I embed this library in my paid commercial SaaS without asking anyone?
expected_behavior: Flag BSL 1.1 Additional Use Grant restriction and advise licensor/legal review; do not call it permissive open source.
